subject: Mobile Development
title: Dark Mode: More Than a Trend
description: One-minute skill: Dark Mode: More Than a Trend.

hook.text: Dark mode turns backgrounds black and text white. It's the most requested phone feature.

buildup.text: On OLED screens, dark mode saves battery because black pixels are completely off.

discovery.text: Studies show dark mode reduces eye strain in low-light environments.

twist.text: In bright sunlight, dark mode is actually harder to read than light mode.

climax.text: Most modern apps support both modes, switching automatically based on time of day.

punchline.text: Black pixels save power on OLED screens.

quiz.question: Why does dark mode save battery on OLED?
options: Black pixels are completely turned off
